inheritedFindings.claim: The replacement wrapper keeps IMMUTABLE but drops the PARALLEL SAFE marker the renamed v2 validator carries, so a CHECK constraint on PromptRefinerReservationStage now calls a parallel-unsafe function; correctness is unaffected (the STRICT loss is inert because a STRICT function also yields NULL on NULL input, and every argument column is NOT NULL), only planning is.
inheritedFindings.reproduction: Apply the migration to an empty database, then run: SELECT proname, proparallel, proisstrict FROM pg_proc WHERE proname IN ('prompt_refiner_runtime_manifest_valid','prompt_refiner_runtime_manifest_v2_valid'); the v2 validator reports proparallel='s', proisstrict=true, while the new wrapper reports proparallel='u', proisstrict=false. Adding PARALLEL SAFE (and optionally STRICT) to the wrapper restores parity.
